set.body: Implement the chief-approved ADR 0003 importance carrier from post-01M1742YA3FK1BFZQT9Y3FAK. Add an unforgeable private-constructor non-case WeightedCoverage carrying ScoreEstimate, conditioningWeight, and count Coverage. Preserve three states: zero observed leaves -> Missing(AllMissing); observed leaves with zero total weight -> Missing(Undefined(ZeroTotalWeight)); positive weight -> Observed(numerator/weight). Production-path discriminator must hold eligible count, conditioning weight, and numeric value fixed while one-heavy versus two-light observed leaves differ only in Coverage. SignatureProjection/codecs/reports preserve both conditioning weight and coverage; record the carrier as an ADR 0003 amendment. Scope excludes uniformCoverage, external/distorted terms, distortedByFacet, and perUnitLocalizability. Do not start until Slice E releases align/signature.scala and a full uninterrupted ownership window exists.
set.title: align: carry importance weight conditioning and leaf-count coverage together
